node.label: Reduced leukocyte N-sulfoglucosamine sulfohydrolase activity
node.definition: Concentration or activity of N-sulfoglucosamine sulfohydrolase as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

evidence.snippet: Mucopolysaccharidosis type IIIA: Reduced leukocyte N-sulfoglucosamine sulfohydrolase activity [TAS]
